categories.main_business_segments: Dohwa Engineering operates primarily in comprehensive civil engineering design, construction technology services, and construction across all SOC (social overhead capital) sectors. The company is expanding into renewable energy EPC and O&M, investment development projects, and high-value PMC services. Its revenue is mainly from engineering services, power sales, and energy storage systems (ESS).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced engineering design and construction management technologies, including platform-based design infrastructure, CAE-based optimal design, and BIM (Building Information Modeling) technologies. It also develops smart construction engineering technologies and digital infrastructure for engineering services. Renewable energy projects utilize EPC methods, and ESS operations involve energy storage and demand response technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include national and local governments, government-invested institutions, international organizations such as the World Bank, and private sector clients. Major markets are infrastructure sectors like water, urban development, transportation, and energy, including overseas markets in developing countries. The company also serves power utilities through renewable energy power sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: Dohwa Engineering operates domestically in South Korea and internationally, with subsidiaries and projects in countries including Vietnam, Poland, Colombia, India, and Kyrgyzstan. Overseas projects focus on developing countries and emerging markets, often funded by international financial institutions and government aid agencies.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, providing engineering design, construction management, EPC services, and facility operation and maintenance. It does not manufacture physical products but delivers professional engineering and construction services, including project development and investment roles.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding overseas markets, diversifying into EPC and O&M businesses, and developing high-value-added services like PMC. R&D focuses on digital transformation of engineering through platform development, BIM, CAE, and smart construction technologies. The company also invests in renewable energy technologies and sustainable infrastructure solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service contracts for engineering design, construction management, EPC projects, and facility maintenance. Additional income comes from renewable energy power sales under long-term power purchase agreements and ESS operations that optimize electricity usage and costs. The company also earns from investment development projects and consulting services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Dohwa Engineering is a leading comprehensive engineering firm in South Korea, holding a significant domestic market share (approximately 22.7% in 2022) and ranked among the top global design firms (87th globally in 2023 by ENR). Competitors include other major Korean engineering firms such as Yushin, Korea Engineering Consultants, and Byucksan Engineering. Dohwa's competitive advantage lies in its large, highly skilled engineering workforce and extensive project experience.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 575 billion KRW in 2023, showing a 3.4% increase from the previous year. Operating profit increased by 83.4%, and net income surged by over 1,200%, reflecting improved profitability. Total assets reached about 605 billion KRW, with steady growth in both domestic and international operations. The company maintains a solid credit rating (AA+).
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dohwa Engineering emphasizes its comprehensive engineering capabilities across the entire SOC lifecycle, from planning and design to construction and maintenance. It differentiates through advanced digital engineering technologies, a large pool of expert engineers, and integrated service offerings including EPC and PMC. Its renewable energy projects and overseas market presence further enhance its value proposition by combining technical excellence with global reach.
